summary: BIONIC V3 Hotspots P0 Certification Finale testing complete. All 4 P0 features working: 1) Leaflet interactive map with polygons, 2) Enriched territory data (GPS, ville, code postal, altitude, territory type, access status), 3) Gestionnaire/Proprietaire access panel with contact button, 4) Annual scheduler with BCE-4X report. Backend: 14/14 tests pass. Frontend: All UI elements functional.

minor.issue: AdminPage.jsx uses /api/admin/* endpoints that return 404 - should use /api/v1/admin/* pattern

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warnings: <tr> cannot be child of <span>, <option> cannot be child of <span>. This is caused by dynamic rendering wrappers, does not affect functionality.

issues: Map renders correctly with dark CartoDB tiles and orange/red polygons - no design issues found

frontend_tests.extraction_button: PASS - Triggers extraction, shows loading state
frontend_tests.extraction_summary: PASS - Shows 300 hotspots, 12 regions, 10 MAJEUR, 290 FORT
frontend_tests.leaflet_map: PASS - Map renders with 300 polygon elements, zoom controls work
frontend_tests.map_table_toggle: PASS - Carte/Tableau buttons switch views correctly
frontend_tests.filters_panel: PASS - 6 filter dropdowns (region, espece, classification, type territoire, acces, categorie)
frontend_tests.table_view: PASS - All 12 columns displayed (ID, Region, Ville, Score, Class., Espece, Territoire, Acces, Alt., GPS, Corr. V9, Action)
frontend_tests.gestionnaire_panel: PASS - Modal opens with territory info, contact details, 'Contacter le gestionnaire du territoire' button
frontend_tests.scheduler_info: PASS - Shows Run # and Prochain date (year+1)

feature_1_leaflet_map.details: Interactive Leaflet map with CartoDB dark tiles, 300 hotspot polygons in red/orange colors, zoom region controls, popups with score/espece/justification/territoire/GPS

feature_2_enriched_list.details: Complete enriched data: GPS (lat/lng), ville, code_postal, altitude_m, territory_type (7 types), access_status (4 statuses), espece, score, justification, accessibility, corridors_v9

feature_3_gestionnaire_access.details: ZEC/Pourvoiries/Reserves have nom/tel/courriel/web, Gouvernemental has ministere/reglements, Autochtone has nation/coordonnees, Prive has lot_info/registre_foncier, 'Contacter le gestionnaire du territoire' button present

feature_4_annual_scheduler.details: POST /scheduler/run triggers extraction, returns scheduler_run number, total_hotspots, next_scheduled (year+1), bce4x_report with PASS status

critical_code_review_comments: AdminHotspots.jsx: React hydration warnings due to dynamic content wrappers - functional but should fix for cleaner rendering
seed_data_creation: None - hotspots are extracted on-demand via POST /scheduler/run
